name: productcard5
title: Shoe Size Selector Card
description: A light product card for a tan suede boot with a heart wishlist toggle, size chips from 7 to 8.5, a $248 price and a blue Add to cart button.
use: An apparel or footwear store needs a self-contained product card with size choice and cart action.
avoid: Sizes are fixed to four shoe values in the code, so other products need a source edit.
a11y: Size chips are clickable spans with no button role or keyboard focus, and the heart button has no label; motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A light card holds a photo of tan suede ankle boots on a pale backdrop, with an outlined heart in the top right. Below sit a bold black title, two lines of small description, four size chips, a $248 price and a blue-gradient Add to cart button with a cart icon.
behaves: Clicking a size chip darkens it to show selection while the others hover-scale under the pointer; clicking the heart fills it white and springs it slightly larger. The Add to cart button has no visible click response in the frames.
customise: The image, copy, sizes and price are hardcoded; the size list, product text and colours must be edited in the file. No props.
weight: light: A few motion springs on the heart and size chips; no continuous loop.
